title: Core: Document serialization schema version
description: Add a schema version field to the FLA serialization format in packages/core/src/fla/serialize.ts and deserialize.ts. When serializing, write schemaVersion: 1 (or current version). When deserializing, check schemaVersion and handle unknown versions gracefully (warn rather than crash). Test: serialized JSON contains schemaVersion field, old docs without it still load.
